title: V2TATC: A Joint Voice-Trajectory Embedding Framework and Dataset for Air Traffic Controller Situational Awareness
abstract: arXiv:2608.28981v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As air traffic volumes in the National Airspace System continue to expand, in particular in the low altitude airspaces, the need for scalable decision support tools used by air traffic controllers will also require more development. This article introduces Voice-to-Trajectory for Air Traffic Control, a joint voice communication-flight trajectory data embedding framework, that can be a component of situational awareness in congested airspaces, and assist the development of tools for ATC as they reason in real-time over Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast trajectories, or the intent expressed by pilots in natural language. We show that these data modalities are not independent and represent a common physical referent: an aircraft flying through the airspace. translated_title: V2TATC：面向空中交通管制员态势感知的语音-轨迹联合嵌入框架与数据集
translated_abstract: 随着国家空域系统中空中交通流量的持续增长，尤其是低空空域的流量不断增加，对空中交通管制员可用的可扩展决策支持工具的需求也将需要进一步的发展。本文介绍了面向空中交通管制的语音到轨迹框架（Voice-to-Trajectory for Air Traffic Control, V2TATC），这是一个将语音通信与飞行轨迹数据进行联合嵌入的框架，可作为拥挤空域中态势感知的组成部分，并协助开发空中交通管制（ATC）工具，使其能够对广播式自动相关监视（ADS-B）轨迹或飞行员以自然语言表达的意图进行实时推理。我们证明了这些数据模态并非相互独立，而是代表着一个共同的物理参照物：即在空域中飞行的飞机。V2TATC 将语音指令与被呼叫飞机的轨迹映射到同一个潜在空间中的相近位置，该空间支持双向查询。它结合了一个自……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出V2TATC框架及数据集，将管制员语音指令与目标飞机的ADS-B轨迹嵌入到同一潜在空间并支持双向查询，为拥挤空域下管制员的实时态势感知与决策支持提供了新途径。
en_tdlr: V2TATC is a joint voice-trajectory embedding framework and dataset that maps ATC voice instructions and the corresponding aircraft trajectories into a single bidirectionally queryable latent space, enabling real-time situational awareness and decision support for air traffic controllers in congested airspace.
